items.description: No seed count, number of repeated runs, standard deviation, or confidence interval is reported for any success-rate/resolve-rate number across Tables 3-7, for either OpenHands agents or baselines. Only a per-instance dollar-cost figure is given for some rows.
items.impact: Bounds the confidence of every measured claim built on these tables; grounds limitation L001.

items.description: Table 1's cell values (which framework has which capability) are missing from the extracted text; only row/column labels remain.
items.impact: Cannot support a specific comparative claim about how OpenHands differs from prior frameworks on any listed capability; Related Work is instead grounded in the authors' own prose characterizations (E046).

items.description: Table 7's numeric block (extended GPQA subsets) could not be reliably mapped back to its rows/columns.
items.impact: The paper reports only the diamond-set GPQA number (E016), which is independently legible and corroborated.

items.description: Appendix H points to an external file/URL (the SWE-Agent demonstration trajectory and OpenHands' own prompt.py) for the CodeActSWEAgent's in-context demonstration; the demonstration's content itself is not included in project/.
items.impact: No claim in this paper depends on the demonstration's content; noted for completeness only.

items.description: paper.txt cites 'Devin (Cognition.ai)' and 'Moatless Tools (Örwall)' without a publication year anywhere in its own text or reference list.
items.impact: These two are named in paper.md as plain system names rather than as formal (Author, Year) citations; see state.json accepted_risk AR006.

items.description: No ablation in paper.txt varies one architectural component (event stream design, sandboxed action space, AgentSkills/ACI library, multi-agent delegation) while holding the others and the backbone LLM fixed.
items.impact: Grounds limitation L006: the causal contribution of any single design choice to the cross-category competitiveness result is untested.
